in_marathi.name: रामदास
in_marathi.long_meaning: रामदास हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rāmadās refers to the servant or devotee of Rāma, a popular Hindu deity. The name is derived from Sanskrit roots ‘rāma’ (pleasing, delight) and ‘dāsa’ (servant). It carries the spiritual message of selfless dedication and devotion to a higher power.
